_about: Sample numeric-check spec for tools/qa_numeric_reproduce.py. Recomputes a disclosure's worked-example numbers from its OWN formulas and checks them against what the draft says. Copy, replace with your case's constants/formulas/numbers. Keys starting with _ are ignored. If the user already has an executable model (e.g. a project *.py with --test-only), prefer reusing that instead of re-encoding formulas here.

_check_types.value_checks: computed expr must match `expect` (independent recompute of a worked value)
_check_types.monotonic_checks: expr must be monotonic in `direction` across `sweep` (catches wrong-direction trend claims, e.g. 'K rises with gap' when it falls)
_check_types.claim_checks: computed expr must match the number `stated` in the draft (catches 'the draft prints a number the formula does not give')

value_checks.name: Vb at h=4500m, d=100um equals draft Table (598 V)
